# Attached-cover packet mux fix

ffprobe and Mp3tag showed that normal tags were present but MP3 and ALAC outputs contained only one audio stream. Investigation found that the converted cover packet was retained in CopiedCover and AVStream.attached_pic but never submitted to the muxer in either the DSRE transcode path or the metadata-only remux path. This revision writes a cloned key cover packet immediately after avformat_write_header and before any audio packet. It then closes the muxer, reopens the completed temporary file, and requires an AV_DISPOSITION_ATTACHED_PIC stream with a non-empty attached_pic packet. Cover write or verification failure now fails the operation instead of silently producing an audio-only file. DSRE-COVER logs include stream index, codec, packet bytes and verification stream details.
